revision_kind: replanning; rounds24-30 not executed by this revision
mission: Find a reproducible raw-digit decoder yielding intelligible text, preferably English, with independently verifiable predictions outside discovery; alternatively establish the original nontextual production process within an authenticated source/version scope.

outcomes.T_validated_translation: Frozen end-to-end rule and key; coherent literal output; independent content and external semantic evidence; separately implemented reproduction. Scope by source/version.
outcomes.G_documented_nontextual_origin: Authenticated evidence of original authorial/generative process without textual message input for specified sources/versions. A newly invented generator alone is insufficient.
outcomes.I_inconclusive: Preserve excluded families, ambiguities, source gaps and computational limits. No forced binary verdict.

logical_limits: Failure to find a decoder does not prove absence of all possible decoders.
An arbitrary lookup table can assign sentences to any finite set of distinct digit strings; fitting such a table is not discovery of the game language.
Nontextual origin does not imply absence of narrative, aesthetic, identification or game-interaction utility.
Different sources and epochs may use different mechanisms; neither a universal cipher nor universal decoration is assumed.

user_requirements.goal: Investigate original production without textual message
Systematic lore and published-research evidence intake
Prioritize Avar Tar, Knightmare and Chayenne
Adjudicate 3478/BEHOLDER/BONELORD as separate lexical, entity, key and historical claims
Adjudicate Hellgate historical grids and finite cryptographic mechanisms
Publish hypotheses, findings and literal potential translations every round

proposed_rounds.name: Sources, lore and published solution claims
actions: Refresh pinned repository changes and published claims
Audit full contexts and variants of the three priority texts
Trace interviews, historical captures, videos and mirrors to their origins
Reproduce eligible published algorithms with an independent check

initial_source_batch.coverage_claim: bounded discovery batch, not exhaustive internet coverage
initial_source_batch.continuation: new primary leads or documented source gaps

proposed_rounds.deliverable: Source/claim registry, context corpus and testable evidence requirements; report inaccessible/unread sources.

proposed_rounds.name: 3478, names and identifiers
actions: Audit literal-name, entity-label, key/seed and coordinated-history claims separately
Reuse existing negative catalog without recounting it as new evidence
Execute only newly specified eligible rules; test full Knightmare and other fixed contexts
proposed_rounds.deliverable: Scoped decision per subhypothesis; suspend active search absent new evidence or mechanism. History-dependent verdict may remain suspended pending R26.

proposed_rounds.name: Hellgate grids and mechanisms
actions: Resolve documented historical gaps when possible
Distinguish partial3x3, reported4x4 and unobserved physical5x5
Close already tested families; admit only specified nonredundant mechanisms with controls and predictions
proposed_rounds.deliverable: Separate decisions for chronology, observed cells/dimensions and each cryptographic family. No invented border cells.

proposed_rounds.name: Qualify hidden-key and segmentation recovery
actions: Distinguish local correctness, known-vocabulary key recovery and hidden vocabulary/boundaries
Include missing digits, names, homophones, ambiguous and identifiable cases
Compare recovery and abstention under a frozen budget on new qualification cases

proposed_gate.required_before_execution: Freeze unit of evaluation, boundary metrics, coverage, consensus/abstention and budget; include exact-recovery and error rates

proposed_rounds.deliverable: Eligibility by scenario or documented failure; not a general English-decoding qualification.

proposed_rounds.name: Literal translation candidates for the three priority sources
conditional_requirements: Relevant method qualified in its own scenario, from R27 or existing evidence
R25/R26 only when a candidate depends on their mechanisms
actions: Freeze framing, lexicon, language, key and model-selection policy
Run complete words/messages with all alternatives and unknown digits preserved
Repeat model/key selection in matched nulls
Freeze transfer predictions before evaluation
proposed_rounds.deliverable: Literal candidate catalog or scoped negative result; advance any strong candidate immediately to R30.

proposed_rounds.name: Textual, nontextual and mixed generators
actions: Qualify discrimination on encrypted English, copied English, nontextual and mixed controls
Charge full model, dictionary, seed, address and exception costs
Test prediction outside fitted motif families where feasible
Search for authenticated evidence of original production
proposed_rounds.deliverable: Scoped model comparison; no universal nonmeaning verdict from compression or fit alone.

proposed_rounds.name: Adjudication and independent implementation
conditional_requirements: A candidate from any round, or the bounded work batch ready for adjudication
actions: Freeze and test genuinely new predictions where such data exist
Audit source and motif dependence
Reproduce with a separately implemented method
Adjudicate T/G/I per source, version and mechanism
proposed_rounds.deliverable: Validated scoped finding or an explicit inconclusive dossier with concrete reopening conditions.

operational_closure: Remove a bounded negative or unsupported hypothesis from the computation queue; do not equate suspension with universal falsity.
reopening_triggers: Demonstrated error in prior implementation or scope
A distinct specified mechanism with an independent falsifiable prediction

candidate_reporting.empty_result: Nenhuma candidata nova; tradução potencial não identificada.
forbidden_repairs: Treating training glosses as independent confirmation

validation_policy.new_lexicon_after_fit: new disclosed exploratory version, not validation
validation_policy.exact_contradiction: Scoped algebraic/exhaustive certificates may reject a specified model without a heuristic-recovery gate; incomplete search cannot.
